name: GloVe
statusSub: Tier 2 passed — independent cold reproduction exited 0 with 8/8 steps
summary: Upstream GloVe trained from scratch on the complete text8 demo recipe: vocabulary construction, co-occurrence generation, shuffle, 15 training iterations and the supplied word-analogy evaluation. The recorded run completed all eleven workflow tasks in 3h07m53s and reported 22.99% total analogy accuracy. The model bundle and evaluation are public. Strict Clean-DAG verification passes 14/14, AI-BOM is 100/100, public URL checks pass, and the dependency freeze is portable. Independent Tier-2 certification passed: the cold rebuild exited 0, ran 8/8 executable steps and regenerated the recorded outputs.
difficulty: 7/10 — the published demo runs without source changes, but its three C compute stages make capture take about three hours and several full attempts were needed; the final record is clean and independently certified
experimentUrlNote: The upstream demo has no experiment-logging integration; there is no logging flag to enable.

certification.stepsNote: Eight run steps rebuilt; the final roar put job was skipped by --no-puts as required.
certification.roarWheelSource: PyPI roar-cli 0.4.5; all six installed tracer binaries matched the sha256-verified wheel byte for byte
certification.manifestDiff: 1/1 EXACT against the union of all recorded run-step pins: numpy==1.26.4, with 0 missing and 0 mismatched. uv pip freeze and importlib.metadata independently agreed at one installed distribution.
certification.venvResolution: The rebuilt venv used Python 3.12.10. PATH resolved python and python3 to the row-local .venv, sys.executable reported that venv, and numpy loaded from its site-packages. The host had no python command before reproduction and the substrate Python could not import roar.
certification.positiveControls: The log contains eight independent success records and Steps run: 8/8; the archive passed tar integrity and contains vectors.bin, vectors.txt, evaluation.txt and vocab.txt; evaluation regenerated 22.58% total analogy accuracy.
certification.hw: 1x NVIDIA Tesla T4, us-east-2, AMI ami-0543bb81ee9303074
certification.costNote: Approximate combined host cost including a discarded preliminary invocation and evidence collection; no conclusion was drawn from the preliminary invocation.
certification.certifiedBy: independent cold agent; did not capture the row and used only the DAG hash, row name, published DAG, public fork and public notes

issues.title: The demo does not set the random seeds exposed by the training binaries
issues.detail: Repeated complete runs produce different analogy accuracy because demo.sh invokes shuffle and glove without their seed flags.
issues.fix: Set and document fixed seeds in the published demo.
